title: Sphere slices of a cycle with the integer slice property
statement: Assume (SL), the exact frozen statement of cmc_slice_mass_bounds, which appears verbatim as the first hypothesis of the Lean statement: for a current T ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U) (U open) represented by (μ, ξ) together with ∂T represented by (μ', ξ') (measures finite on compact subsets of U, a.e. strongly measurable fields with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| a.e.) and an L-Lipschitz f, there are A_t ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U), B_t ∈ 𝒟_k(U) (t ∈ ℝ) with A_t(ω) = ∫_{f<t} ξ(ω)dμ, B_t(η) = ∫_{f<t} ξ'(η)dμ', ∂A_t(η) = B_t(η) whenever tsupport η ∩ {f = t} = ∅, M_W(∂A_t − B_t) ≤ L·liminf_{h↓0} h⁻¹μ(W ∩ {t − h < f < t}) for open W, and the integrated bound. Let P, d ∈ ℕ, C ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P) with ∂C = 0, μ a Borel measure on ℝ^P with μ(K) < ∞ for compact K, ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_{d+1}(ℝ^P) μ-a.e. strongly measurable with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for μ-a.e. x and all α, C(ω) = ∫ξ(ω)dμ for every test form ω, and suppose C has the integer slice property ISP (hypothesis copied verbatim from the parent statement: for all admissible representations of C and ∂C and every Lipschitz f, for L¹-a.e. t, every pair A, B of currents with A(ω) = ∫_{f<t} ξ(ω)dμ, B(η) = ∫_{f<t} ξ'(η)dμ' has ∂A − B integer multiplicity). Let x₁ ∈ ℝ^P. Then there is a Lebesgue-null set N ⊆ ℝ such that for every ρ > 0 with ρ ∉ N there is A ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P) with A(ω) = ∫_{B_ρ(x₁)} ξ(ω) dμ for every test form ω, ∂A integer multiplicity, spt ∂A ⊆ ∂B_ρ(x₁) (sphere x₁ ρ), and M(∂A) ≤ liminf_{h→0, h>0} h⁻¹·μ({x : ρ − h < |x − x₁| < ρ}) (ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹, liminf in [0, ∞] along 𝓝[>] 0).

B t).massOn W ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ (W ∩ {x | t - h < f x ∧ f x < t})) (𝓝[>] 0)) ∧ (∀ (W : Set (Euclid P)) (a b : ℝ), IsOpen W → ∫⁻ t in Ioo a b, ((A t).boundary - B t).massOn W ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * μ (W ∩ {x | a < f x ∧ f x < b}))) → ∀ (P d : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (d + 1)) (x₁ : Euclid P), C.boundary = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), C ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ (μ μ' : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (d + 1)) (ξ' : Euclid P → MultiVector P d), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ' K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ' μ' → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ', ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) d, |ξ' x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), C ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, (C).boundary η = ∫ x, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂μ') → ∀ (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), LipschitzWith L f → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ∀ (A : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1)) (B : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d), (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), A ω = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, B η = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂μ') → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A.boundary - B)) → ∃ N : Set ℝ, volume N = 0 ∧ ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ ∉ N → ∃ A : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), A ω = ∫ x in ball x₁ ρ, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity A.boundary ∧ A.boundary.support ⊆ sphere x₁ ρ ∧ A.boundary.mass ≤ liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ {x | ρ - h < dist x x₁ ∧ dist x x₁ < ρ}) (𝓝[>] 0)
